telaInicial.subtitulo: The brand manual, the files and the intelligence that understands both — in one place.
telaInicial.ler: Read the manual as the studio laid it out, with index and search
telaInicial.baixar: Download logo, icons, palette, fonts and photos, with the rule that governs each file
telaInicial.perguntar: Ask the assistant, which answers citing the manual page
telaInicial.conferir: Check your piece and generate prompts with the brand's DNA
telaInicial.escolha: Pick a brand to get started.

estadoVazio.tituloSemAcesso: You don't have access to a brand yet
estadoVazio.textoImportar: A brand manual is usually a PDF nobody reads and where nobody finds anything. Here it becomes a system that answers questions — and shows where each answer came from.
estadoVazio.textoSemAcesso: Access is granted brand by brand. Ask whoever manages the account to unlock the brands you'll work with, and they will appear here.
estadoVazio.passo1Titulo: Upload the manual as a PDF
estadoVazio.passo1Texto: The text is extracted and becomes a structured draft.
estadoVazio.passo2Texto: Nothing is published until someone confirms it. Whatever hasn't been approved stays marked as a draft.
estadoVazio.passo3Texto: From then on the brand answers questions, checks pieces and delivers the right files.

paginaNaoEncontrada.titulo: This page is not in this manual
paginaNaoEncontrada.texto: The address may be out of date, or the page may belong to another brand in the account. The navigation on the side shows what exists here.

recuperacao.pedidoTexto: Enter the email you sign in to Brennimark with. We'll send you a link to create a new password.

manualOriginal.semTitulo: This brand doesn't have an original manual yet
manualOriginal.semTexto: The original manual is the PDF uploaded at import. Brands created before this screen may not have the file attached — importing again fixes it, and nothing that already exists is deleted.
